name: Bandwidth-based Streaming Interval Calculation
definition: A method to calculate the minimum time interval between data fetches and the number of simulation slices to skip, based on system bandwidth limits to ensure real-time streaming from HDD to GPU.
summary: Bandwidth-based Streaming Interval Calculation determines safe data fetch intervals to ensure real-time volumetric streaming by calculating skip counts based on system bandwidth limits, distinguishing itself from spatial partitioning or hardware-dependent methods.
